d: Sandy-blonde hair is tied into a high ponytail with long bangs framing the face. Bright turquoise, wide-set eyes accompany a youthful, adolescent facial expression on a slender build. The outfit consists of a white open jacket over a black form-fitting bodysuit with cyan accents, paired with black short-shorts, a utility belt with pouches, a single black thigh-high stocking, and black sneakers with cyan piping. Signature accessories include large black and cyan headphones around the neck, black goggles perched on the head, and a black handgun held in one hand.
